challengeQuestions.finding: Operating lease/rental commitments excluded by approved principal-only definition. Loan captions alone do not prove exhaustive finance-lease absence; UNKNOWN retained.

challengeQuestions.question: Interest-bearing related-party payable?
challengeQuestions.finding: Individual Nguyen Thi To Hoai lender in annual loan notes is included in reported gross long loans, never added again. Current related-party remuneration note is not proof that all related financing is absent.

challengeQuestions.question: Debt hidden in other liabilities?
challengeQuestions.finding: Independent visual residual note components in all five periods remain undisaggregated. Contractual terms/counterparties/interest status unavailable for material other payables; this independently defeats complete-population claim.

challengeQuestions.question: Current portion double counted?

challengeQuestions.question: Accrued interest incorrectly included?

Reviewed interim p30 states accruals comprise interest plus received goods/services; current other accrued costs may be operating under this specific policy. This does not classify unexpanded other payables.

challengeQuestions.question: Financing liability outside borrowing note?
